function.name: criminal_record_get_offense_nature
function.description: Get details about the nature of offenses committed by a criminal. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: criminal_record_get_status
function.description: Find the conviction status of a criminal in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

region.description: Region where criminal record is to be searched.
